system.description: This small globe breaks when thrown to the floor, flooding the area with thick, black smoke. Encumbrance: 1 All lines of sight into and through the area affected by the smoke bomb are broken for 1 turn. Taking action through the smoke adds {Dc} {Dc} to any checks that rely on the sense of sight. A smoke bomb can be thrown within close range. No check is necessary to throw the smoke bomb, but roll a single {Dc}. On a {Dc}, the throw goes astray and lands somewhere inconvenient, such as at your feet, determined by the GM.
